title: Output of retouche-prompt: the same video prompt, edited minimally

refonte.description: false when a local edit carries out the instruction (the normal case). true only when the instruction asks to rebuild the plan, so that no local edit would honour it.

raison.description: (French) Why a local edit is not enough: one short sentence when refonte is true, an empty string otherwise.

sections.description: The six sections of the prompt, complete. A section that needed no change is copied exactly as given. All empty strings when refonte is true.

modifications.description: (French) One short sentence per edit made: what changed and in which section. Empty when refonte is true.
